_readme: 651 Belmont autoboard project definition, transcribed from 'Bathroom Design Recommendations and Product Links' (prepared 2026-09-16). These are PROPOSED design selections, not an approved purchase order or a construction specification — nothing here is quoted, sampled or released. `status` records that: preferred = the current recommendation, alternative = a substitute for the preferred row directly above its group (never an additional material to combine with it), pending = named in the document as an open selection with no product identified. Row order matters: scripts/autoboard/lib/match.mjs assigns a preset slot to the FIRST matching row, so the preferred pick for each slot is listed before its alternatives. Feed this file to scripts/autoboard/scaffold-project.mjs, which writes the library root the autoboard CLI reads (build_manifest_v2.csv + Master_Library_Build/_BUILD_LOG.csv). Tiles are real manifest rows here, unlike the Wieland library — so tile-assignments.json stays Wieland-only and must not gain 651 Belmont keys.

rooms.note: The dark slim tile in the rendering is INSIDE a niche; the earlier advice to remove it as a wall stripe was withdrawn. Grounded is a terracotta/clay-look collection — Alabaster was chosen for its pale character, not an orange terracotta effect. ELM Vivid Ligne Noir is the matte relief (204221E), distinct from ordinary Noir. Do not combine all three neutral tile routes.

rooms.identity: Penthouse (unit 3) kitchen — Thermador Pro Harmony suite, panel-ready
rooms.note: Transcribed 2026-09-17 from the live Smartsheet FINISH DATABASE: 651 Belmont (sheet 6391628162879364), Unit Type = Penthouse, Cost Code = 11 30 Appliances - T&M. Only rows NOT flagged AGENT IGNORE are carried: the sheet holds many superseded duplicates of the same appliances. Each row keeps its Smartsheet row id. Three further live Penthouse appliance rows sit in the Laundry room — LG washer WM4000HBSS, LG gas dryer DLGX4001BSS and the Thermador T18IW905SP wine column — and are deliberately not here: no board type maps to Laundry. One data discrepancy carried as-is rather than silently corrected: K-04’s SKU reads MC30WPSS, which no manufacturer sells; the product is MC30WP (see that row’s photo note).
